# NoAway

> NoAway is a desktop productivity app for macOS 11 (Big Sur) or later and Windows 10/11 (64-bit). NoAway keeps your computer active while it is switched on. Whether Teams or Slack show you as Available also depends on permissions and on the conditions listed in Help. It prevents system idle at the OS level and does not interact with, inject into, or modify Teams or Slack. NoAway does not send activity, usage or personal data. The keep-active feature runs entirely on your computer. The only network request is the license check, which sends your license key and a device identifier so the license works on one device. One license works on one device. Updates are emailed to buyers with a direct download link. One-time launch price €4.99 (EUR)—no subscription, no free trial. Support: support@noaway.app

Base-URL: https://noaway.app/
